newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Compared with Monday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers up $0.50-$1.00 per cwt Tuesday, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest mostly moderate. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1350 lbs 70.50-72.00 east to 70.00 ld 69.50 .
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1300 lbs 70.50-72.00 east to 70.00.
Most cattle delivered to packing plants with weighing conditions equivalent to 3 percent shrink at feedlots with some being bought on a picked up (FOB) basis.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Mondays close - Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00, instances $2.00 higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1350 lbs 114.00-115.00 few to 113.00 few pt lds Select 112.00 Holstein (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 105.00 Holstein (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 106.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00.
